description: Agentic behavior hooks: saves prompts to history on submit, syncs rules via symlink, auto-syncs memory to git repo on session start and task completion, enforces sub-agent output-to-file pattern

hooks.prompt:
Check the agent prompt/description for file output instructions. Sub-agents MUST save substantial output to a file (not return it inline) to avoid context bloat.

Look for instructions like 'save to file', 'write output to', 'save findings to', 'write results to', or a specified output file path.

If the prompt does NOT include file output instructions, respond with a systemMessage reminding the caller to add file output instructions. Do NOT block the call — just remind.

If file output instructions ARE present, approve silently.
